summary: Implemented Lambda and Lambdad transforms. Lambda is appended to monai/transforms/utility/array.py; it asserts callable(func) with "func must be callable" and returns func(img). Lambdad is added to monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py after ConcatItemsd: it validates keys via MapTransform, builds one internal Lambda(func), and for each key applies it to a dict(data) copy. Aliases LambdaD and LambdaDict are appended after the ConcatItemsD line. The import edits add Callable to the typing import and Lambda to the array import list. Docs entries were added to docs/source/transforms.rst (Lambda before SplitChannel, Lambdad after ConcatItemsd). Tests were added in tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py. Nothing was committed, and tests, flake8, and black were not run. The dictionary module diff removes only the original typing import line. No added line exceeds 120 characters.
